result.description:
The QA Lead is responsible for driving quality governance, test strategy and delivery assurance across large scale digital banking programs, including mobile banking, payments, onboarding and mortgage lending workflows. This role ensures secure, stable and compliant releases across customer facing channels and core banking systems, with a strong focus on risk, regulatory alignment and APRA ready documentation. Experience working with major Australian banks including Westpac-style delivery models, governance frameworks and release processes is highly valued.

Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end test strategy, planning, estimation and QA governance for digital banking and mortgage-lending initiatives.
Oversee test execution across mobile apps, web platforms, payments systems, mortgage origination workflows and customer-onboarding journeys.
Conduct risk-based testing, impact analysis and mitigation planning aligned to APRA CPS 230, CPS 234 and internal bank standards.
Partner with business, engineering, architecture and product teams to ensure compliant, high-quality releases across critical banking journeys.
Facilitate defect triage, drive resolution of high-severity issues and provide go/no-go recommendations.
Translate business requirements into test scenarios, traceability matrices and audit-ready documentation.
Lead automation uplift across UI, API and end-to-end flows to improve release velocity and reduce manual regression effort.

Provide clear QA status reporting, risk visibility and stakeholder communication across delivery streams.
Mentor QA engineers, uplift capability and embed best practices across squads.
Ensure QA artefacts (DSRs, TCRs, traceability) meet compliance, audit and regulatory expectations.

Must have
Proven experience as a QA Lead or Test Manager in major banks or regulated financial institutions.
Strong understanding of digital banking journeys, payments flows, KYC, onboarding and mortgage-lending processes (document assessment, credit decisioning, workflow orchestration).
Hands-on experience with mobile and web application testing across complex, multi-system environments.
Experience working within Westpac-style governance, risk reporting, release management and delivery frameworks.
Expertise in risk-based testing, defect management and release governance.
Experience leading automation using modern frameworks (e.g., Playwright, API automation).
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across business and technology.
Ability to lead cross-squad QA delivery in Agile / scaled Agile environments.
Experience producing audit-ready QA documentation and compliance artefacts.
result.title: Test Lead

result.description:
Fitter (Full-Time)

Employer: General Transport Equipment Pty Ltd
Position: Fitter
Employment Type: Full-Time Permanent
Location: Kewdale, WA 6105
Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation

GENERAL TRANSPORT EQUIPMENT PTY LTD is currently seeking an experienced Fitter to join our growing team in Kewdale, WA 6105. Due to continued business growth, we are looking for a motivated and reliable tradesperson to support the assembly, fitting, installation, repair, and maintenance of transport equipment, mechanical components, and related systems.

This is a full-time permanent position offering an annual salary of $75,000 – $85,000 plus superannuation, depending on skills and experience.

Key Responsibilities
Read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and workshop documentation.
Assemble, fit, install, and modify mechanical components, transport equipment, and related systems.
Perform mechanical fitting, repairs, adjustments, and maintenance activities on trailers, semi-trailers, and associated equipment.
Inspect, test, and measure completed work to ensure accuracy, quality, and compliance with required standards.
Diagnose mechanical faults and carry out repairs, servicing, and preventative maintenance.
Use hand tools, power tools, and specialised equipment to complete fitting and mechanical tasks.
Ensure all work is completed in accordance with workplace health and safety requirements and quality procedures.
Maintain a safe, clean, and organised workshop environment.
About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:

A relevant trade qualification as a Fitter, Mechanical Fitter, or equivalent.
A minimum of 1–2 years of relevant experience as a Fitter or in a similar mechanical fitting role.
Experience working with mechanical components, equipment assembly, repairs, and maintenance.
Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
The ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.
The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
A strong commitment to quality workmanship and workplace safety.

What We Offer
Full-time permanent employment.
Annual salary of $75,000 – $85,000 plus superannuation.
A supportive and professional working environment.
Opportunity to work with specialised transport equipment and mechanical systems.
Ongoing training and career development opportunities.
Monthly staff lunches and additional employee benefits.

If you are an experienced Fitter looking to join a well-established and growing company, we encourage you to apply.

About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Backup & Storage Administrator to join our Managed Services team supporting mission-critical telecommunications infrastructure and enterprise platforms. The successful candidate will be responsible for the administration, monitoring, maintenance, optimization, and lifecycle management of enterprise backup and storage environments, ensuring high availability, performance, data protection, business continuity, and disaster recovery in accordance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

Key Responsibilities: 

Storage Administration: 
Administer and support enterprise storage environments across Production, UAT, Development, Test, and Disaster Recovery environments.
Manage SAN, NAS, Fibre Channel, iSCSI, and enterprise storage infrastructure.
Perform storage provisioning, LUN allocation, zoning, masking, expansion, and capacity management.
Monitor storage health, performance, utilization, and availability using enterprise monitoring tools.
Perform storage performance tuning and optimization.
Support storage replication, snapshots, cloning, and disaster recovery solutions.
Perform firmware upgrades, storage migrations, lifecycle management, and maintenance activities.
Troubleshoot and resolve storage-related incidents within agreed SLA and KPI targets.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures.

Backup Administration:
Administer and support enterprise backup infrastructure.
Configure and manage backup policies, schedules, retention policies, and media management.
Monitor backup jobs and ensure successful completion of backup and restore operations.
Perform backup recovery testing and validation.
Manage backup replication between Production and Disaster Recovery environments.
Perform backup infrastructure upgrades, patching, and maintenance.
Support disaster recovery exercises and business continuity testing.
Troubleshoot failed backup jobs and optimize backup performance.
Ensure backup compliance with security, governance, and retention requirements.

Operational Support:
Collaborate with Database, VMware, Linux, Windows, Network, Security, and Application Support teams.
Participate in Incident, Problem, Change, Release, and Capacity Management processes following ITIL best practices.
Develop operational documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures.
Ensure compliance with operational procedures, security standards, and governance requirements.
Identify automation opportunities and implement continuous service improvements.
Participate in planned maintenance activities and 24x7 on-call support rotations.

Required Experience:
Minimum 4 years of experience in Enterprise Backup and Storage Administration.
Experience working within Managed Services or Enterprise Infrastructure Operations.
Experience supporting large-scale enterprise backup and storage environments.
Experience working in mission-critical production environments with strict SLA and KPI commitments.
Experience supporting Telecommunications, Service Providers, or large enterprise environments is highly desirable.
Experience working in 24x7 operational support environments.

Next Steps
If you would like to express interest in the role, please click on the APPLY button now. Due to the high number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion within 3-5 business days. We thank you for taking an interest in this opportunity with us.
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Salary: From $90,000 AUD per annum plus Superannuation

About the Role

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced and qualified Insurance Loss Adjustor to join either our AMA Group Solutions or Capital S.M.A.R.T Repairs team to undertake quality workmanship to ensure vehicles are returned to their pre-accident condition. This is a full-time position located in all areas of Regional QLD.

The primary purpose of this role is to be responsible for the timely completion of accurate and comprehensive quotes for accident repairs on vehicles. You will apply your knowledge of motor vehicles and your skills with computers whilst interacting with a range of people.

With around 3,500 people across approximately 150 locations, we deliver outstanding customer service and get over 300,000 people and businesses back on the road every year. With AMA Group, you can go anywhere.

 

 CAPITAL SMART 

With over 50 repair centres across Australia and New Zealand, Capital S.M.A.R.T is the industry leader We are the pioneers of customer satisfaction and innovation standards, and pride ourselves on providing our employees with safe, supportive, and rewarding working conditions. With an extensive network across Australia and New Zealand, as part of our Team, you can go anywhere.

 

ACM PARTS

ACM Parts is Australia’s largest provider of alternative and specialty parts to the automotive repair industry, keeping vehicles on the road. We are reimaging the way vehicles can be repaired by providing a choice of options that suit their needs. We offer a comprehensive range of Reclaimed, Genuine, and Aftermarket parts as. ACM Parts is reinventing the quality and service standards of the repair industry. It’s our mission to re-define and repair.

 

The Opportunity
We have an exciting opportunity for Centre Manager at either of our AMA Group Solutions or Capital S.M.A.R.T Repairs team. This is a full time position. 

Reporting to the State Operations Manager, you will take ownership of this centre by providing leadership and motivation to your team whilst having a significant impact on the day to day operational running of the site. This permanent full-time role will be provide you with opportunities for growth, stability and security as part of the bigger AMA Group. 

Role responsibilities
Production Workshop Management: oversee production management of the workshop to ensure targets are achieved and vehicles are repaired to their pre-accident condition in accordance with AMA and Work Provider quality expectations.

Job Details
-  Occupation: Project Administrator
-  Base Pay: $80,000 - $90,000 + Super
-  Contract Type: Permanent
-  Work Type: Full Time
-  Industry: Height Safety Services
-  Sector: Privately Held Company

About the Role
Safe Height Pty Ltd trading as SAFE MOUNT are a specialist provider of Height Safety Compliance  Solutions across SEQ. Our services include System Design, Installation of Height Safety Systems, Certification and Audit, as well as Harness & PPE Inspection services. Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Project Administrator to support the planning, coordination and administration of multiple concurrent projects and service programs for the existing and new clients. The role requires regular travel along southeast Queensland between various projects with possible interstate trips. This role suits a highly capable, analytically-minded professional — potentially with an engineering, scientific, mining or other complex industrial background — who can quickly learn technical and regulatory frameworks, interpret data and adapt across multiple concurrent, complex projects as per various customers’ requirements. 

Skills
-  Project Coordination
-  Contract Administration
-  Contract Management
-  Project Scheduling
-  Microsoft Excel
-  Project Reporting
-  Contractor Management
-  Stakeholder Management
-  Compliance Management
-  Document Control
-  Change Management
-  Data Analysis
-  Bluebeam Revu 

Skills & Experience
-  Tertiary qualification in a technical, engineering, scientific, project management, business or related discipline.
-  Background in engineering, construction, mining, resources, manufacturing or other complex industrial/technical sectors will be highly regarded.
-  Minimum 3 years’ experience in project coordination, project administration, project controls or similar project support roles.
-  Demonstrated experience managing interfaces between clients, contractors, suppliers and technical professionals.
-  Experience coordinating projects involving technical design, site installation works, contractor management and regulatory compliance requirements.
-  Experience in schedule monitoring, progress tracking and project performance reporting.
-  Experience in communication with different levels of stakeholders from site labour to decision makers in the client's procurement team
-  Experience supporting project change management and contract variation processes.
-  Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including reporting, forecasting, data analysis and performance tracking.
-  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
-  Strong analytical and organisational abilities.
-  Demonstrated ability to rapidly learn, analyse and apply new technical, regulatory and operational information across complex, fast-moving project environments.
-  Reading CAD drawings and liaising with Design Project managers and Development Managers

Main Duties / Responsibilities
-  Coordinate and administer height safety compliance inspection programs, system installation projects, and design services.
-  Develop, maintain and review project schedules, work programs, resource plans and project documentation.
-  Prepare and coordinate tender documentation, service agreements, work orders and contract documentation, ensuring project requirements, pricing, scope changes and approvals are accurately recorded throughout the project lifecycle.
-  Coordinate day-to-day communication and workflow between clients, engineers, contractors, installers, inspectors and suppliers to ensure activities are delivered safely, efficiently and in accordance with project schedules.
-  Monitor project and service delivery performance against contractual requirements, compliance obligations and client expectations.
-  Act as a key point of contact for clients, contractors and suppliers by coordinating responses to project enquiries, facilitating communication between stakeholders and assisting with the timely resolution of operational issues.
-  Maintain accurate electronic project records, inspection reports, certification documentation, drawings, registers and compliance documentation to support project delivery and audit requirements.
-  Compile project performance information from multiple operational sources, analyse trends and prepare management reports covering project progress, productivity, compliance performance and service delivery outcomes.
-  Support project change management processes, including assessment, documentation and tracking of project variations.
-  Monitor contractor activities against agreed schedules, scopes of work and project milestones, identifying delays, quality concerns or scope changes requiring management review.
-  Support procurement and subcontractor coordination activities.
-  Prepare project documentation including client reports, operational summaries, project status updates, meeting papers and internal business documentation to support decision-making.
-  Provide project support to senior management by monitoring project risks, escalating critical issues, coordinating follow-up actions and assisting with implementation of operational decisions.
-  Identify delivery risks, compliance issues and operational constraints that may affect project schedules or client commitments.
-  Coordinate height safety inspection, installation and certification activities to ensure compliance with regulatory and client requirements.
-  Monitor contractor performance and support continuous improvement initiatives across projects and service programs.
Experience
-  To be considered for this role, applicants must demonstrate a minimum of 3 years’ experience in project coordination, project administration, project controls or similar project support roles within engineering, construction, industrial services, infrastructure, compliance or other relevant technical service environments. 

Performance Goals
-  Timely delivery of height safety projects and annual compliance service programs.
-  Effective planning, scheduling and delivery of projects from tender stage to practical completion and handover
-  Accurate and effective project reporting.
-  Efficient coordination of contractors, suppliers and stakeholders.
-  Compliance with contractual, regulatory and client requirements.
-  Continuous improvement of project administration, reporting and coordination processes.

Other Requirements
-  Current, open driver’s licence, with willingness to travel regularly across South East Queensland and occasionally interstate.

How to Apply
Submit a resume and cover letter to info@safemount.com.au or via the application link.
We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, cultural background, disability or other protected attributes.

Position Overview:
Ebcon is an Australian-owned construction, civil works and maintenance company delivering infrastructure, road maintenance, restoration, and electrical works projects for councils, government agencies and commercial clients. The company is recognised for its commitment to quality workmanship, safety, compliance and reliable project delivery.

As an Estimator at Ebcon, you will be responsible for preparing accurate cost estimates and tender submissions for a diverse range of civil construction and infrastructure projects. This position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to work collaboratively with project teams.

Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Evaluate and interpret civil engineering, infrastructure and construction drawings, specifications and contract documentation to prepare accurate cost estimates for infrastructure, road maintenance, restoration and electrical works projects.
•	Conduct quantity take-offs and prepare detailed cost estimates using industry-standard estimating software.
•	Prepare detailed cost estimates, tender submissions, feasibility assessments and pricing proposals for civil construction, maintenance and infrastructure projects.
•	Liaise with subcontractors, suppliers and service providers to obtain competitive quotations for labour, materials, plant and specialised services.
•	Analyse project risks, cost variations and scope changes, preparing updated estimates and forecasts throughout the tender and project lifecycle.
•	Review project specifications, site conditions and client requirements to identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality, safety and compliance standards.
•	Collaborate with project managers, engineers and operational teams to develop practical estimating solutions that support successful delivery of infrastructure and maintenance projects.
•	Maintain accurate estimating records, cost databases and tender documentation, ensuring submissions comply with council, government agency and commercial client requirements.

Qualifications and Skills:

•	Relevant qualification.
•	Minimum 1 year experience as an Estimator.
•	Strong understanding of civil construction methodologies, materials and cost structures.
•	Proficiency with estimating software and Microsoft Office Suite.
•	Excellent analytical, numerical and communication skills.
•	Ability to manage multiple tenders and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Salary:
The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $79,000 – $95,000 p.a. plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.
